correctness.rationale: Four explicitly derived orthogonal projectors reduce every possible entry sign to two stated quartics. Complete coefficient sign checks for all n>=3, a>0, b>=0, Descartes one-root arguments and h=0/threshold boundary checks prove exact iff and all finite failure horizons; 26712 exact rational tests independently reproduce spectral and full-matrix formulas. The asymptotics follow by expansion of the positive quadratic root.

originality.rationale: The comparison separates the known general Padé positivity limitations, special uniform-weight complete multipartite formulas, and related matching-weight controllability from the genuinely distinct two-sided fourth-order positivity phase interval, its unique finite failure horizons, and the crown n=6 transition. value.rationale: Fourth-order A-stability alone does not preserve positive states. For natural matched bipartite diffusion networks this solves both unconditional safety and exact finite timestep admissibility, with two distinct failure modes, a sharp n=6 crown transition and an asymptotic 5/4 matching-weight ceiling. These are substantive structural network-design facts, not isolated checks.
